answer.reason: The settlement Carmel in Judah is the setting of Nabal's sheep-shearing and of David's servants coming to take Abigail as his wife.

clauses.english: was where Nabal had his possessions and sheared his sheep
clauses.quote: he was shearing his sheep in Carmel

clauses.english: was where David's servants came to take Abigail to be his wife
clauses.quote: David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.

doubts: Verses on mount Carmel (Elijah's contest with the prophets of Baal, Elisha and the Shunammite, the border of Asher) probably concern the mountain, not this settlement, so I left them out.

Verses calling Abigail, Hezrai or Hezro a Carmelite only name the place of origin, and the prophetic verses (Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos, Nahum, Song of Solomon) use Carmel as a figure, so none of them gave a clause.
JOS 12:22 'Jokneam of Carmel' may refer to the mountain district, so it is uncertain whether the summary's Carmel is the same as the settlement in Judah.
